title: The Greedy Little Bear | Honey Sharing Song for Kids | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A little bear finds a jar of honey and learns that sharing makes everything more fun.
A sweet, bouncy song about kindness, friendship and sharing with others.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers who are learning to share.

Bear, bear, look, what's there?
A honey jar, so sweet and fair!
Yum, yum, yum, yum
Honey for me, hooray!

Yum, yum, honey, share, share, share
more fun when we share!
Sweet, sweet, sweet, sweet
Share with me, hooray!

Gulp, gulp, the bear eats all
down, down, the sticky drip falls
drip, drip, drip, drip
oh my, oh my, what a mess!

Yum, yum, honey, share, share, share
more fun when we share!
Sweet, sweet, sweet, sweet
Share with me, hooray!

Rabbit hops, "I'm hungry, please,"
Squirrel sits, "My tummy's squeeze!"
Bear looks down, the jar is light
one last spoon for you, hooray!

Yum, yum, honey, share, share, share
more fun when we share!
Sweet, sweet, sweet, sweet
Share with me, hooray!

Amma smiles, "Come wash your paws,"
everyone licks their fingers, hooray!
Ha, ha, ha, ha
Honey friends, see you again!
